messages:
Ellen Meyer: Hey team — my monitor arrived but the VESA bracket is slightly off-center and the HDMI cable sits at an angle. Also the USB-C->Ethernet dongle has no serial sticker so I can't register it with the ticket. Wi‑Fi also keeps prompting for cert. Anyone on IT or logistics I should ping?

Karen (Logistics): @Ellen Meyer sorry about that. Can you DM me the order number? I can check if we shipped a replacement monitor stand. If it's minor we can send a torque bracket. :package:

Ellen Meyer: Order #RWI-22478. I filed a ticket but didn't get an update yet. Thanks!

Josh (IT): @Ellen Meyer I pulled the ticket (INC-9876) and assigned it to me. For the dongle serial—if it's a black sticker, sometimes it's on the inner flap. Can you drop a photo? If missing we can issue a replacement or register by MAC address.

Ellen Meyer: Photo attached (see thread). MAC is 3c:5a:37:9b:1e:02.

Josh (IT): Ok got it. I'll claim a replacement dongle and flag inventory. Meanwhile you can use the laptop's USB-C network adapter: plug the ethernet into your dock's upstream port and enable "USB Ethernet" in network settings. If you need a temporary static, run:
```
sudo nmcli con add type ethernet ifname usb0 con-name temp-wired autoconnect yes
sudo nmcli con up temp-wired
```
(replace usb0 with the interface name from ifconfig)

Alex Chen: Welcome Ellen! If you want, I have a spare dongle at my desk you can borrow until the replacement arrives. :grinning:

Ellen Meyer: Thank you! Wi-Fi cert prompt is still weird — it asks for a domain cert when I try corpwifi. Josh any tips?

Josh (IT): If you're on Mac, open Profiles in System Preferences and reinstall the corp cert. Or run the MDM enrollment again:
```
/Applications/CompanyMDM/enroll.sh --sso
```
I'll push a cert to your device; should pop up in ~2m.

inventory-bot: Replacement dongle RMA created (RMA-4523). Shipment ETA 2 business days.

Josh (IT): Pushed cert and added a note to INC-9876 to replace the VESA screw set. I'll follow up here once RMA ships.

Ellen Meyer: Awesome, thanks all! Saved the temp steps and borrowed dongle offer. :thumbsup:
